Ivy: Plan. Do. Reflect.

Daily commitment and reminders

Only for iPhone

Free · In‑App Purchases

iPhone

No more never-ending to-do lists. No more overcommitting. Feel good about your days. Ivy lets you start fresh every morning, focus on what matters, and call it done in the evening. Try Ivy free for 14 days. No separate registration required. How it works: In the morning - Start on a fresh canvas with the weather forecast, your all-day events, and the interests you want to focus on. - Choose what to work on from your Ideas list. - Begin your day. Your top three items appear on the iPhone Lock Screen. During the day - Block distractions with Focus Shields. - Give each task your full attention in an immersive, full-screen Focus Session. - Keep your current task in view with Live Activities on iPhone and Apple Watch. - Get credit for the time you put in, even when you don't finish a task. In the evening - Close your day. Your Focus Shields are lifted, and unfinished tasks return to your Ideas list. - Celebrate your accomplishments with an immersive 3D experience. - Revisit what you completed, what you worked on, and for how long in your journal timeline. - Tomorrow starts empty. Many ideas – no overwhelm - Organize your ideas by interest. - Your Ideas list stays compact, showing only the top three ideas from each interest. - Dive into each interest for long-term planning. So much more - Recurring tasks. - Notes, notifications, and alarms. - Voice input (requires a device that supports Apple Intelligence) and Home Screen widgets. - Apple Calendar and Reminders integration. - Flag items as super tasks. - Scheduled items automatically appear in chronological order. - Import from other apps. 14-day free trial - Try Ivy free for 14 days. No separate registration required. - Ivy offers monthly and annual subscriptions, as well as lifetime access with a one-time purchase and no recurring charges. Your subscription starts when you begin the free trial, but you won't be charged during the trial. After 14 days, your subscription automatically renews at the paid rate shown when you subscribe, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the trial ends. - All options provide full access to Ivy on all supported devices. - Prices may vary by region. Subscription payments are charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription through your Apple Account subscription settings. Privacy Policy: https://semantical.com/privacy Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Reach us at hello@semantical.com.

- An interest section's task count label is hidden when expanding it wouldn't reveal more tasks. This makes your Ideas list easier to scan. - The Focus view auto-advances on completion only when opened via a task's fullscreen button. - Count goal increments logged within 60 seconds of each other merge into one journal entry. - Ivy takes up less storage. - Fixed the chart of redeemed time in Shields not showing its bars. - Various reliability and polish improvements.
